functions.macro: SELECT CASE  WHEN (is_histogram_other_bin(bin)) THEN ('(other values)') WHEN ((((NOT (can_cast_implicitly(bin, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT)) OR can_cast_implicitly(bin, CAST(NULL AS "DOUBLE")) OR can_cast_implicitly(bin, CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP)))) AND (technique = 'auto')) OR (technique = 'sample'))) THEN (CAST(bin AS VARCHAR)) WHEN ((row_number() OVER () = 1)) THEN (concat('x <= ', CAST(bin AS VARCHAR))) ELSE concat(lag(CAST(bin AS VARCHAR)) OVER (), ' < x <= ', CAST(bin AS VARCHAR)) END AS bin, count, bar(count, 0, max(count) OVER ()) AS bar FROM histogram_values("source", col_name, bin_count := bin_count, technique := technique)

functions.macro: WITH bins AS (SELECT CASE  WHEN ((((NOT (can_cast_implicitly(min(col_name), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT)) OR can_cast_implicitly(min(col_name), CAST(NULL AS "DOUBLE")) OR can_cast_implicitly(min(col_name), CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP)))) AND (technique = 'auto')) OR (technique = 'sample'))) THEN (approx_top_k(col_name, bin_count)) WHEN ((technique = 'equi-height')) THEN (quantile(col_name, main.list_apply(generate_series(1, bin_count), (lambda x: (x / CAST(bin_count AS "DOUBLE")))))) WHEN ((technique = 'equi-width')) THEN (equi_width_bins(min(col_name), max(col_name), bin_count, CAST('f' AS BOOLEAN))) WHEN (((technique = 'equi-width-nice') OR (technique = 'auto'))) THEN (equi_width_bins(min(col_name), max(col_name), bin_count, CAST('t' AS BOOLEAN))) ELSE "error"(concat('Unrecognized technique ', technique)) END AS bins FROM query_table(CAST("source" AS VARCHAR)))SELECT unnest(map_keys(histogram)) AS bin, unnest(map_values(histogram)) AS count FROM (SELECT CASE  WHEN ((((NOT (can_cast_implicitly(min(col_name), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT)) OR can_cast_implicitly(min(col_name), CAST(NULL AS "DOUBLE")) OR can_cast_implicitly(min(col_name), CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP)))) AND (technique = 'auto')) OR (technique = 'sample'))) THEN (histogram_exact(col_name, bins)) ELSE histogram(col_name, bins) END AS histogram FROM query_table(CAST("source" AS VARCHAR)) , bins)
